evidence.claim: MIAG produce a Braunschweig carrelli industriali antideflagranti, con una storia che parte dal 1846 e oltre 150 punti di contatto nel mondo.
evidence.quote: With a history dating back to 1846 and special know-how that has grown for more than 90 years, MIAG Fahrzeugbau GmbH, located in Braunschweig, successfully serves the national and international market with explosion-protected industrial trucks. || More than 150 contact possibilities all over the world guarantee customer-oriented advice, sales and service. || Our equipment is used in the following sectors, among others: chemical and pharmaceutical industry, paint factories, explosives industry, automotive industry, refineries, oil rigs, cosmetics industry
